summary: Expanded the universe around the student-loan servicing and education-payments infrastructure node. The best-fit public names are not education brands; they screen as specialty finance, government BPO, vertical payments, and fintech infrastructure. Nelnet is the cleanest reference asset because its filings directly identify Loan Servicing and Systems plus Education Technology Services and Payments. Flywire and Maximus are underfollowed infrastructure candidates tied to higher-ed payments/student financial workflows and federal student-loan borrower servicing. Fiserv is a hidden component supplier because Maximus disclosed that transferred Navient accounts continued on a Fiserv-owned student-loan servicing platform, but Fiserv's total-company exposure is likely diluted.
